name: asana
description: Maps 107 bounded operation-backed direct reads, 12 stream-backed interactive read commands that still need a one-provider-request bound, and 130 approval-gated one-record direct writes. All 12 streams support saved full-refresh ETL; project-scoped tasks additionally support source-backed event-token incremental modes; all 130 write actions support warehouse-table reverse ETL. The pinned OpenAPI ledger accounts for every official operation as an executable covered_by route or the one not-applicable generic batch wrapper.

risk.read: 107 operation-backed commands are bounded source reads; the 12 stream-backed interactive commands use declared streams but still need an explicit one-provider-request/page/fanout bound; saved full-refresh ETL remains separate and exhaustive; no raw provider query/path passthrough
risk.write: external mutations require named write actions, schemas, previews, explicit approval, and typed destructive confirmation when destructive/admin; interactive commands are one-record direct writes while warehouse-table reverse ETL remains system-level
risk.approval: all write execution follows plan -> preview -> explicit approval -> execute; destructive actions also require confirm: destructive
